note: Adapted from Emerson's monograph on the termites of Kartabo; the original is in English. In the body of the original the species appears under the combinations Japritermes (Neocapritermes) bodkini Silvestri and Capritermes (Neocapritermes) bodkini, and the synonymy also lists Silvestri's 1923 var. modestior, which Emerson regarded as no more than a size difference caused by the age of the nest. In the measurement table the row labels for pronotal length and hind tibia length are damaged by OCR and have not been translated; the ratio in the original sentence 'Pronotum about 1%…' is illegible, so only the measurements are recorded and not the ratio.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head rather pale brown, broadly oval, bearing a few long setae. Fontanelle slightly darker than the head, large and round. Muscle impressions in front of the ocelli indistinct. Antennal segment 3 shorter than segment 4, segment 4 shorter than segment 2; or segment 3 longer than segment 2 and segment 2 equal in length to segment 4. Compound eyes medium-sized and projecting, about 1/4 of an eye diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli medium-sized, their distance from the eye about equal to their own length. Postclypeus about the same colour as the head, the mid-longitudinal line distinct. Pronotum about the same colour as the head, with short hairs and setae; rather broad, the posterior margin deeply concave, the corners and sides rounded. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum broadly concave or with a rather small notch, this character varying considerably between individuals. Abdominal tergites rather pale brown. Measurements: head length 2.14—2.36 mm, head width 1.93—2.10 mm, eye diameter 0.52—0.53 mm, pronotum length 0.86—0.87 mm, pronotum width 1.60—1.75 mm, hind tibia length 2.62—2.67 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, sparsely covered with short setae, widest posteriorly, narrowing toward the front, with a distinct line from the back of the head to the opening of the frontal gland. Antennae tinged with brown, 15—16-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length. Labrum pushed to one side to accommodate the mandible, its tip rounded. Mandibles asymmetrical, black; the left mandible more strongly curved than in C. angusticeps and less strongly than in C. planiceps. Thorax yellow, pronotum about 1.40 mm wide, its anterior margin concave. Legs yellow. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents, its tergites with a few marginal setae. Measurements: total length 9.00—12.10 mm, head with mandibles 6.82—7.26 mm, head width 3.70—3.73 mm, antennal length 4.46 mm, pronotum width 1.40 mm, left mandible length 3.58 mm.
